verdict.rationale: Tilled offers webhooks that push real-time notifications about platform events to your application ([tilled-docs-4], [tilled-docs-23]). That gives you an event trigger, but you must write and host your own handler logic to turn events into actions. The evidence shows no native rule builder or automation engine for defining conditions and actions inside Tilled. Missing for 10: a native rule or automation builder, condition-to-action configuration, documentation of webhook event types and filtering, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
